highlights.title: Every web filter on iPhone
highlights.detail: The iPhone app has the same filters as the web: categories and sub-categories, merchants, items, accounts, countries, search and excluded rows. Tap a value once to show it, again to hide it and a third time to clear it. The filters apply to Summary, Activity, Insights and Items, and the server computes the filtered totals.

highlights.title: Items, rules and bulk edits on iPhone
highlights.detail: The iPhone app has an Items tab, a Rules page with Review, Conflicts and the version history, and rule actions on each transaction. Select rows in Activity to rename payees or change their category in one edit.

highlights.title: Dashboard charts on iPhone
highlights.detail: Summary shows the spending chart per day, per month or as a running total, grouped by merchant or category, with the comparison and trend lines. Trends now opens from Summary.
